body: Re-tighten `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:1095-1118`. This test explicitly disables shrimp mortality at `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:1048-1049`, but the updated day-60/day-90 envelopes now accept `shrimp_count(0, ...)`, `juveniles_count(0, ...)`, and zero reproductive readiness. That means a total colony collapse after an early hatch pulse would still satisfy the checkpoint envelopes, materially weakening the regression that is supposed to guard the controlled ideal reproduction path. Restore non-zero floors at those checkpoints.
